name: a fully paid invoice whose every line is OUTSIDE the agreement's eligible categories earns nothing

expected.workings: The agreement's eligibleCategories is ['procedure'] and neither line is one, so eligibleBase = 0 even though the invoice was paid in full. settleable = 156000 - 0 = 156000. collected = 156000 - 0 = 156000. targetBase = divHalfUp(0 x 156000, 156000) = floor((0 + 156000) / 312000) = 0. target = percentAmount(0, 1500) = 0. delta = 0 - 0 = 0, and a zero delta appends NO row at all -- the ledger stays empty rather than filling with zeroes.
